**Review of the search ad**

Channel: search ad. Short copy still needs evidence, so I checked each claim.

- "Tea Subscription UK": a plain description of the product and market. Fine.
- "Monthly loose leaf tea.": a product fact. Fine.
- "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time.": on the brand's approved claims list. Fine.
- "Free UK delivery on orders over £25.": on the approved list, and the £25 threshold is stated right next to the claim, as required. Fine.

There are no superlatives, statistics, health or green claims, guarantees, urgency language or testimonials. The copy is plain and has no AI clichés or filler. The brand's own channels and ads don't need an "Ad" label in a search result beyond the platform's normal marking, which the ad platform supplies.

Nothing needs changing, so it can go out.
